rules.title: Python 3.9 and older are end-of-life
rules.summary: These Python release lines no longer receive security or bug fixes from the Python core team.

constraints: Keep project metadata, local version files, CI matrices, containers, and deployment runtimes on a mutually supported Python version.
Confirm binary wheels and framework dependencies support the selected Python release.

steps.title: Update the Python requirement
steps.instructions: Raise the reported requires-python range or pinned runtime to a supported Python release.

steps.title: Align runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update matching version files, CI matrices, container images, and deployment configuration.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Python runtime is supported.
Run the Python test suite on the target runtime.
Check installed dependency compatibility.

rules.title: nose is maintenance-only
rules.summary: The project warns that nose has been in maintenance mode for years and recommends alternatives for new projects.

constraints: Choose one target test runner before editing tests and preserve discovery rules, fixtures, setup/teardown behavior, plugins, and command-line options.

steps.title: Choose the target runner
steps.instructions: Select pytest, nose2, or unittest based on the suite features and existing project tooling.

steps.title: Migrate nose usages
steps.instructions: Replace reported imports, runner calls, test_suite configuration, and nose-specific assertions or plugins.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove nose from dependency declarations and add the selected runner and required plugins.

verification.purpose: Run the migrated test suite with pytest when selected.
Check standard-library test discovery when applicable.
Check installed dependency compatibility.

rules.title: django-nose is maintenance-only
rules.summary: The package states that it is in maintenance mode and recommends pytest or Django unittest for new projects.

constraints: Preserve Django settings selection, database setup, fixture loading, test labels, and any django-nose plugin behavior.

steps.title: Choose the Django test runner
steps.instructions: Select pytest-django or Django's built-in test runner and document the chosen invocation.

steps.title: Migrate runner configuration
steps.instructions: Replace TEST_RUNNER, imports, plugins, and django-nose-specific options at every reported usage.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove django-nose and add only the target runner and plugins required by the suite.

verification.purpose: Run Django's configured test suite.
Run the suite through pytest-django when selected.
Check installed dependency compatibility.

rules.title: PyCrypto is obsolete and vulnerable
rules.summary: The archived project warns that PyCrypto 2.x is unmaintained, obsolete, and contains security vulnerabilities.

constraints: Treat this as a security-sensitive migration: preserve algorithms, modes, key sizes, padding, nonces or IVs, authentication tags, and serialized ciphertext formats.
Do not silently change cryptographic primitives or defaults without explicit compatibility and security review.

steps.title: Choose the maintained library
steps.instructions: Select pycryptodome for a closer Crypto namespace migration or cryptography for a higher-level maintained interface.

steps.title: Migrate cryptographic usages
steps.instructions: Update every reported import and operation, making keys, modes, padding, nonces, tags, and encoding explicit.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove pycrypto, add the selected maintained package, and regenerate the environment lock data.

steps.title: Verify cryptographic test vectors
steps.instructions: Confirm known plaintext/ciphertext vectors and backward compatibility with persisted encrypted data.

verification.purpose: Run cryptographic vectors and repository tests.
Check installed dependency compatibility.

rules.title: sklearn is deprecated on PyPI
rules.summary: The sklearn maintainers state that the PyPI package is deprecated and that scikit-learn is the actual distribution name.

constraints: Keep Python imports as sklearn; only the distribution name used by installers and dependency metadata changes.

steps.title: Replace the distribution name
steps.instructions: Replace sklearn with scikit-learn in dependency declarations and installation commands without renaming sklearn imports.

steps.title: Refresh the environment
steps.instructions: Regenerate lock data and confirm the intended scikit-learn version resolves for every supported Python runtime.

verification.purpose: Check the resolved scikit-learn environment.
Run model, preprocessing, and repository tests.

rules.title: distribute is deprecated
rules.summary: The project describes Distribute as a deprecated Setuptools fork whose code was merged back into Setuptools.

constraints: Preserve build backend behavior, package metadata, entry points, and supported installer environments.

steps.title: Replace Distribute
steps.instructions: Replace distribute requirements and bootstrap scripts with setuptools and remove distribute-specific installation logic.

steps.title: Verify package builds
steps.instructions: Build source and wheel distributions in a clean environment and inspect their metadata and entry points.

verification.purpose: Check the packaging environment after replacement.
Run packaging and repository tests.

rules.title: pep8 was renamed to pycodestyle
rules.summary: The maintainers renamed the pep8 project to pycodestyle to reduce confusion.

constraints: Preserve selected checks, ignore lists, file exclusions, maximum line length, and CI failure behavior.

steps.title: Replace pep8 with pycodestyle
steps.instructions: Replace the dependency, commands, imports, and configuration section name with pycodestyle equivalents.

steps.title: Compare style results
steps.instructions: Run both configurations on the same source tree and review any changed diagnostics before removing pep8.

verification.purpose: Run the replacement style checker with project configuration.

rules.title: pyinj is archived on PyPI
rules.summary: PyPI marks pyinj as archived, and the maintainers state that the repository is no longer maintained.

constraints: Preserve provider scopes, binding resolution, constructor injection, overrides, and application startup behavior.

steps.title: Replace pyinj with injx
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and imports, then translate bindings and injection declarations to the injx API.

steps.title: Verify the injection graph
steps.instructions: Exercise application startup, nested dependencies, scopes, overrides, and missing-binding errors.

verification.purpose: Run dependency-injection and repository tests.

rules.title: pytest-runner is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer warns that pytest-runner depends on deprecated Setuptools features and can bypass pip security mechanisms.
rules.replacement: tox, nox, or direct pytest invocation

constraints: Preserve test dependencies, pytest options, environment variables, supported Python versions, and CI exit behavior.

steps.title: Remove pytest-runner
steps.instructions: Remove pytest-runner from setup requirements and move test dependencies out of tests_require.

steps.title: Add an explicit test runner
steps.instructions: Configure tox, nox, or the existing environment manager to install test dependencies and invoke pytest directly.

verification.purpose: Run the test suite without setup.py test or pytest-runner.

rules.title: ipaddr is superseded
rules.summary: The project states that ipaddr was superseded by the Python standard-library ipaddress module and its Python 2 backport.

constraints: Preserve IPv4 and IPv6 parsing, strictness, network boundaries, address ordering, exception behavior, and text formatting.

steps.title: Replace ipaddr
steps.instructions: Replace the dependency and translate IPAddress, IPNetwork, and related usages to the standard-library ipaddress API.

steps.title: Verify address behavior
steps.instructions: Test IPv4, IPv6, malformed input, host bits, networks, containment, and serialization used by the application.

verification.purpose: Run networking edge cases and repository tests.

rules.title: django-celery is no longer required
rules.summary: The project states that django-celery is no longer required because Celery supports Django directly.

constraints: Preserve task discovery, broker and result settings, periodic schedules, worker startup, retries, and Django application initialization.

steps.title: Adopt Celery's Django integration
steps.instructions: Configure the Celery application using the current Django integration and translate djcelery settings and setup calls.

steps.title: Remove django-celery
steps.instructions: Remove django-celery and djcelery from dependencies, installed applications, imports, commands, and migrations after data needs are resolved.

verification.purpose: Run task, scheduling, result-backend, and repository tests.

rules.title: datacommons is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainers state that datacommons is no longer maintained or functional and direct users to datacommons-client.

constraints: Preserve API endpoints, authentication, statistical-variable identifiers, entity queries, response shapes, pagination, and retry behavior.

steps.title: Replace the Data Commons client
steps.instructions: Replace datacommons with datacommons-client and translate client construction and API calls using the official migration guide.

steps.title: Verify query results
steps.instructions: Compare representative entity, observation, and graph query responses and error paths against expected fixtures.

verification.purpose: Run Data Commons integration and repository tests.

rules.title: vsdeband is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer marks vsdeband as deprecated and directs users to the vsjetpack package.

constraints: Preserve filter selection, thresholds, planes, grain behavior, frame formats, and rendered video output.

steps.title: Replace vsdeband
steps.instructions: Replace the dependency and translate vsdeband imports and filter calls to their vsjetpack equivalents.

steps.title: Compare rendered output
steps.instructions: Render representative clips and compare frame properties and visual output around gradients and motion.

verification.purpose: Run video-processing and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: multimodal-timesfm is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The maintainer states that multimodal-timesfm was renamed and is no longer maintained under that name.

constraints: Preserve model identifiers, checkpoints, preprocessing, forecast horizons, covariates, device selection, and output shapes.

steps.title: Replace multimodal-timesfm
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and translate imports, model loading, and forecast calls to tsfmx.

steps.title: Compare forecast behavior
steps.instructions: Run pinned fixtures through both packages and compare shapes, missing-value handling, and forecast tolerances.

verification.purpose: Run forecasting and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: saroku was renamed to trikesh
rules.summary: The maintainer states that saroku was renamed and is no longer maintained under that name.

constraints: Preserve command behavior, configuration, output formats, and any persisted state.

steps.title: Replace saroku
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and translate saroku imports and commands to trikesh equivalents.

verification.purpose: Run affected command and repository tests.

rules.title: seofleet-cli is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer renamed seofleet-cli to llmscout-cli and states that no further releases will be published under the old name.

constraints: Preserve scan targets, configured checks, output formats, exit codes, and CI invocation.

steps.title: Replace seofleet-cli
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and CLI invocation with llmscout-cli, then migrate configuration using the current project documentation.

verification.purpose: Run CLI integration and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: superlinked-server is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer identifies superlinked-server as a legacy package deprecated for new projects and directs users to SIE Server and sie-sdk.

constraints: Preserve model selection, indexing, query behavior, deployment settings, authentication, and response contracts.

steps.title: Adopt SIE
steps.instructions: Deploy SIE Server, replace the legacy package with sie-sdk, and translate server and client configuration to the current interfaces.

verification.purpose: Run inference, indexing, query, and repository tests.

rules.title: goobook is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The maintainer states that the project is no longer maintained.

constraints: Preserve contact fields, address-book search, authentication, caching, and command output used by scripts.

steps.title: Select a maintained contacts client
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained Google Contacts or CardDAV client, export or preserve local state, and replace goobook commands and integrations.

verification.purpose: Run contact lookup, synchronization, and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: imagej was renamed to pyimagej
rules.summary: The maintainers state that the imagej Python package was renamed to pyimagej.

constraints: Preserve ImageJ initialization, JVM options, endpoints, datasets, conversions, and headless behavior.

steps.title: Replace imagej with pyimagej
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and verify imports and initialization against the current pyimagej API.

verification.purpose: Run ImageJ integration and repository tests.

rules.title: poetry-version-plugin is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer states that poetry-version-plugin is deprecated and recommends migrating to other project and versioning tools.

constraints: Preserve the version source, tag format, source-tree state, built metadata, editable installs, and release automation.

steps.title: Replace dynamic versioning
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained versioning workflow, migrate Poetry configuration and release jobs, and remove poetry-version-plugin.

verification.purpose: Build distributions and inspect their resolved versions.

rules.title: api-shield is deprecated
rules.summary: The maintainer renamed api-shield to waygate and states that no further releases will be published under the old name.

constraints: Preserve feature flags, rollout state, rate limits, maintenance windows, storage, and framework adapters.

steps.title: Replace api-shield
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution, change shield imports and commands to waygate, and migrate configuration using the maintained documentation.

verification.purpose: Run policy, rollout, rate-limit, and repository tests.

rules.title: asyncio-requests is retired
rules.summary: The maintainer states that asyncio-requests is retired and that development continues under the asyncio-gateway name.

constraints: Preserve HTTP, SOAP, FTP, and SFTP behavior, TLS verification, retries, processors, response envelopes, and error handling.

steps.title: Replace asyncio-requests
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and asyncio_requests imports with asyncio-gateway interfaces, then review the documented breaking and security changes.

verification.purpose: Run protocol, TLS, response, and repository tests.

rules.title: opennms-api-wrapper was renamed
rules.summary: The maintainer renamed opennms-api-wrapper to python-opennms and states that no further releases will be published under the old name.

constraints: Preserve server URLs, authentication, timeout and TLS settings, resource queries, pagination, and response models.

steps.title: Replace the OpenNMS client
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and migrate opennms_api_wrapper imports to the opennms module provided by python-opennms.

verification.purpose: Run OpenNMS client and repository tests.

rules.title: apisec-code-bolt was renamed
rules.summary: The maintainer states that apisec-code-bolt was renamed to apisec-surface and receives no further releases under the old name.

constraints: Preserve authentication, configuration, saved credentials, scan scope, manifest output, upload behavior, and CI exit codes.

steps.title: Replace apisec-code-bolt
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution with apisec-surface and verify the renamed command, while retaining compatible state and configuration documented by the maintainer.

verification.purpose: Run APIsec CLI integration and repository tests when defined.
